stem:
A student drops a ball and measures the height of the ball while it is bouncing. The table shows the height of the ball in inches, y, after it has bounced x times.

Bouncing Ball

| Number of Bounces, x | Height of Ball, y (inches) |
|---------------------|-------------------------------|
| 0                   | 72                            |
| 1                   | 43.2                          |
| 2                   | 25.9                          |
| 3                   | 15.6                          |
| 4                   | 9.3                           |

Which exponential function best models the data?
visual_elements: table with values for number of bounces x and height of ball y
